doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Upcoming LA gig with Al Grey, Sweets Edison and Junior Mance
summary: His next gig is in LA with The Elders and then work with Al Grey, Harry Edison, Junior Mance and a drummer.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: My next gig. what about it?

Where is it. It’s in LA, next week with The Elders. And I guess I’m going to be working with Al Grey, Harry “Sweets” Edison, Junior Mance and a drummer, Bobby Dorn. We’re going to be doing some things on the west coast.
All right. Junior Mance. ©Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Oh yeah. That’s going to be some fun. Talk about dance. And sex and deep fried foods and booze.
Sounds like the best of the times to me.
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. We’re going to have fun.
